newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore defence chief to visit Australia.
newsitem.headline: Singapore defence chief to visit Australia.

text.p: Singapore Defence Minister Tony Tan will visit Australia for talks with his counterpart there to boost security ties between the two nations, a joint statement by the two countries said on Thursday.

It said Tan would meet with his Australian counterpart Ian McLachlan and sign an agreement for the Singapore Air Force (SAF) to establish a training facility for helicopter pilots at the Australia Army Aviation Centre at Oakey, west of Brisbane.
"Singapore appreciates the training opportunities which Australia has provided to the SAF as there is a severe shortage of training space in Singapore," the statement said.
Tan will also meet Australian Prime Minister John Howard. He is due to arrive on Saturday and return home next week.
